jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Program Manager is responsible for owning customer programs from handoff through execution, ensuring alignment across Sales, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations. This role drives schedule adherence, communication clarity, and issue resolution for active programs, with a strong focus on execution discipline, customer requirements, and risk management.
The Program Manager serves as the internal owner for assigned programs, ensuring that commitments made to customers are clearly understood, documented, and executed across all functions and facilities.
Must be willing to travel up to 40%

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Own assigned customer programs from internal handoff through production execution and delivery
Serve as the primary internal point of contact for program coordination, ensuring alignment between Sales, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations
Maintain clear program schedules, milestones, and deliverables; proactively identify risks to cost, schedule, or quality
Ensure customer requirements, approvals, and documentation are clearly captured, communicated, and followed
Coordinate internal reviews and cross‑functional meetings to support program execution and issue resolution
Track program status, open actions, and risks; escalate issues early with clear recommendations
Support customer communication in partnership with Sales, ensuring consistent messaging and follow‑through
Proactively coordinate and escalate schedules with outside processors, suppliers, and material partners to prevent delays and maintain workflow continuity
Monitor material flow, identify risks or bottlenecks, and drive timely resolutions through effective communication and collaboration across internal and external teams
Ensure changes in scope, requirements, or priorities are documented, communicated, and aligned internally
Partner with Quality and Engineering on customer-driven requirements, approvals, and corrective actions
Support new program launches, including onboarding, documentation alignment, and readiness reviews
Drive continuous improvement in program execution, communication flow, and handoff processes
Travel to Prince facilities and customer sites as required

Required Skills and Attributes

Strong organizational and execution skills with the ability to manage multiple active programs
Clear, direct communicator; able to align cross‑functional teams and manage expectations
Strong attention to detail and follow‑through
Ability to identify risks early and drive resolution
Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, manufacturing environment with tight customer requirements
Strong problem‑solving skills with a practical, execution‑focused mindset
Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with ERP and project tracking tools preferred
Ability to work effectively across multiple facilities and functional teams

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, or a related field preferred
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in project management, program management, or operations within a manufacturing environment
Experience supporting aerospace, space, defense, or other regulated industries strongly preferred
Prior experience coordinating cross‑functional teams required

Physical Job Requirements

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Must be able to access and navigate production facilities
Ability to travel as required to support programs across facilities

Benefits

Blue Cross Blue Shield Medical insurance (PPO and HDHP with HSA) w/ Prescription Coverage

Dental PPO Insurance
Vision PPO Insurance
Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Insurance
Company Paid Life Insurance and AD & D - Including options to add on additional life insurance for yourself, spouse & children
Critical Illness Insurance
Accident Insurance
401(k) Fidelity Plan with strong employer match
Personal Retirement Advisor
Generous PTO Policy and 9 Paid Holidays per year
100% Tuition Reimbursement for Job-Related Classes
Personal Protective Equipment reimbursement (safety glasses, shoes, etc.)
Uniform Rental Service
Employee Events

Due to ITAR regulations, only U.S. persons—defined as U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (Green Card holders), and U.S. nationals—are eligible for this position.

This position is contingent upon contract award.

The Program Manager will lead a geographically dispersed, cross-functional team operating within a multi-project, multi-vendor federal environment. The selected candidate must be available to travel to the Washington, DC metropolitan area as needed to support onsite meetings, program activities, and customer requirements.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

Lead the Program Management Office and oversee the cost, schedule, technical performance, staffing, quality, and contractual performance of multiple projects and programs.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer, Contracting Officer's Representative, Government Program Manager, Government personnel, subcontractors, and teaming partners.
Manage the Integrated Program Schedule, program milestones, resource allocations, staffing plans, budgets, forecasts, risks, deliverables, and performance metrics.
Lead program reviews and provide timely, transparent reporting on financial performance, technical progress, risks, issues, corrective actions, and contract status.
Ensure cross-functional integration among technical, operational, administrative, Government, subcontractor, and contractor teams while rapidly coordinating responses to urgent program issues.

Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience, with at least 15 years of program or project management experience supporting contracts of comparable size and complexity.

Demonstrated experience managing multi-task contracts, subcontracts, diverse contract types, and multi-vendor federal delivery environments.
Project Management Professional certification with expertise in requirements analysis, resource allocation, project costing, deliverable tracking, risk management, schedule management, and financial reporting.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities, including the ability to respond effectively to complex cost, schedule, staffing, and technical challenges.
Excellent written and verbal communication, customer engagement, team leadership, and collaboration skills, including experience managing geographically dispersed teams.

Experience leading programs operating within Agile, DevSecOps, and cloud-native development environments.
Experience managing large federal IT programs involving enterprise data platforms, analytics, cybersecurity, and mission-critical system modernization.

U.S. Citizenship is required.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Aviation Delivery
jobs.description:
About Us

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

What You'll Do

Refining communication across the globe – our clientele spans from domestic to international, encompassing both commercial and government sectors, showcasing our adaptability to diverse communication needs worldwide. Viasat is looking for a creative, bright, and innovative Technical Program Manager to work at the forefront of what makes us successful. This is an outstanding opportunity to collaborate with our dedicated engineers in developing and supporting technology programs within Viasat's Aviation business.

This Technical Program Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of software delivery requests from Commercial and Business Aviation customers from inception through Entry Into Service, including requirements gathering, planning, development and delivery. You will have experience working with a variety of engineering teams (system architects, software, integration, and test), handling schedule and performance risk, meeting commitments and anticipating and mitigating problems. In addition, you will be developing stakeholder relationships and working effectively with various functional areas within the company. You will be leading, directing, and motivating cross-discipline teams across multiple organizations and geographic sites.

The Program Manager will build effective relationships with business, engineering development teams, product management teams and project stakeholders to help facilitate the execution of software delivery projects / programs and to improve end to end operational efficiency of engineering domains. This is a one-to-many role responsible for consistent, predictable delivery waves across the global account base.

The Program Manager must have a foundational knowledge of theories, practices and procedures related to Program/Project management. The PM must be able to apply knowledge and skills to complete their assigned work autonomously with minimal direction. The ideal candidate has a background in Program/Project management, systems engineering or software development, Scrum/Agile and a mindset centered around critical thinking.

The day-to-day

Build and maintain software product delivery plans that span all aviation accounts and timelines
Host stakeholder planning and review meetings for all aviation account’s delivery items
Work with Product Management to develop cross-domain delivery item prioritization
Manage and maintain delivery requirements across intake and development tools (e.g., JIRA, Monday.com)
Ensure requirements are normalized, validated and clear with Business, Product, Engineering, and partners
Work with Engineering, Operations, and Partner teams to track and regularly report on delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and success metrics for all delivery items to drive cross-team alignment and accountability
Proactively identify risks, dependencies, delays, and blockers - driving mitigation plans and escalate effectively when needed
Capture lessons learned from each delivery wave and implement continuous improvement

What You'll Need

Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience in Engineering
5-10 years of experience in Project Management focused on software development
4+ years experience as a software or systems engineer on product development projects
Demonstrated ability to monitor, lead and report project level milestones, risks, issues, and decisions
Extensive problem-solving skills, and ability to drive resolutions to closure
Demonstrated ability understanding sophisticated systems at a system architectural level
Ability to lead project communications internally to teams/partners/leadership and externally to customers
Understanding and experience with project management methodologies and standard processes
Experience working within Agile Development Frameworks
Experience handling project scope and deliverables, including change control methodologies
Experience with commercial or business aviation industry preferred
Experience with scaled Agile implementation preferred

What Will Help You On The Job

Strong communication skills (written and verbal) and intrapersonal skills; ability to interact with all levels in the organization
Strong organizational skills to handle multiple projects concurrently, for multiple customers
US citizenship or permanent residency preferred.

Salary range

$120,500.00 - $190,000.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $149,500.00- $224,500.00/ annually

At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Learn more about Viasat’s comprehensive benefit offerings that are focused on your holistic health and wellness at https://careers.viasat.com/benefits.

Konrad is a next generation digital consultancy. We are dedicated to solving complex business problems for our global clients with creative and forward-thinking solutions. Our employees enjoy a culture built on innovation and a commitment to creating best-in-class digital products in use by hundreds of millions of consumers around the world. We hire exceptionally smart, analytical, and hard working people who are lifelong learners.

About The Role

This role is part of our Digital team, where your internal title will be Senior Specialist, Digital; working primarily in a strategic leadership capacity across client engagements. As a Program Manager, you excel at orchestrating complex, multi-stream programs that deliver exceptional digital products and experiences, while driving alignment between client business goals and cross-functional project teams.

You are a strategic thinker with a high capacity for navigating ambiguity. You bring a strong ability to manage portfolios of projects, oversee large-scale budgets, and mitigate risks across multiple workstreams while ensuring high-quality, on-time delivery. You are comfortable advising senior client stakeholders and are motivated to elevate both your team’s delivery performance and your consulting expertise.

In this high-impact role, you will lead the evolution of client engagements, guiding programs from initial strategy and discovery through to successful delivery, while contributing to broader digital consulting initiatives including organizational transformation, portfolio management, and process governance.

What You'll Do

Lead and manage complex, multi-stream digital programs, ensuring the successful delivery of integrated digital solutions

Drive delivery excellence across cross-functional teams (Strategy, UX Design, and Technology), fostering collaboration and removing high-level blockers
Act as the strategic point of contact for senior client stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment on business objectives, and proactive issue resolution
Identify systemic risks, proactively developing mitigation strategies to keep programs on track and drive continuous improvement
Collaborate with teams to interpret complex business challenges and translate them into actionable, multi-phase delivery roadmaps
Facilitate and lead high-level workshops, including executive steering committees, strategic discovery, and portfolio planning sessions
Oversee the structure of presentations, program reports, and other key client-facing deliverables

Qualifications

Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in project or program management, preferably within a digital agency or consulting environment
Proven success managing large-scale, cross-functional digital programs (design and/or technology)
Strong mastery of project management methodologies and portfolio management best practices
Proven ability to manage complex budgets, resource allocation, and program scope effectively

A demonstrable passion for digital transformation, user experience, and modern technology

Exceptional organizational skills with a keen eye for high-level detail

Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.
401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting
Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year
11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan
Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
$500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year
Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month
Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month
Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

We're looking for a Project Manager, Site Selection to own end-to-end coordination of our site acquisition pipeline — from initial market intake through lease execution and handoff to delivery — across multiple concurrent real estate transactions with varying site types. This role sits at the center of a cross-functional process spanning Construction, Engineering/Design, Network Engineering, Finance, Security, Tax, and Legal, and requires someone who can keep a high-volume pipeline moving with precision, flag risk early, and drive deals to close.

Key Responsibilities

Own the site selection project portfolio end to end across multiple active sites simultaneously — from initial intake and market screening through term sheet negotiation, due diligence, internal cross-functional review, deal approval, contract negotiation, and lease execution.
Coordinate cross-functional site reviews across disciplines (Construction, Engineering/Design, Network, Finance, Security, Tax): assigning owners, defining completion criteria, and holding the line on deadlines.
Drive due diligence workflows, including document/data reviews, site visits, and go/no-go decision packages, partnering closely with site selection, construction, and operator teams.
Manage lease negotiation logistics: letter of intent drafting and signature, scope of work development, internal deal approvals, and coordination with external counsel through contract review and execution.
Maintain a single source of truth for site status, health, target lease signature dates, and portfolio-level reporting to leadership.
Identify and escalate risk — schedule slippage, unowned workstreams, data discrepancies (e.g., conflicting site addresses or tracker inconsistencies) — before they threaten a deal timeline.
Coordinate with operators, brokers, and internal stakeholders (Sales, Tax, Legal, Network Engineering, Construction) to keep every function aligned on the same site data and timeline.
Support tax and incentive analysis by compiling accurate site location data (address, legal description, coordinates, estimated investment value) for internal tax teams and local government partners.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in data center site selection, real estate acquisition, infrastructure development, or related commercial real estate, ideally supporting hyperscale, cloud, or AI infrastructure customers.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent, high-value real estate transactions from intake through close, with strong attention to accuracy and follow-through.
Working knowledge of power/utility infrastructure, fiber/carrier availability, zoning and permitting, and regional tax incentive structures.

$130,000 - $`150,000

jobs.description:
Company Description

Charlie’s Produce - Who We Are

Charlie's Produce is a privately owned wholesale produce company. We are the largest privately owned produce wholesaler on the West Coast, and we are growing. The secret to our success in this industry is PEOPLE! We strive to hire the best and we reward them with a working environment that fosters loyalty, stability, innovation, and growth.

Charlie’s was founded in quality, and we are proud that it is still our focus. With a team of dedicated people who are passionate about food, supply chain, and their community we are looking for like-minded individuals to help further our goal to enhance our communities through quality produce.

What We Offer

An amazing company culture
Medical/Dental/Vision on the first of the month following hire
ESOP (Profit Sharing) and 401(k)
Paid vacations, paid holidays
Coverage under State Sick Leave
100% Prepaid College Tuition for employees and their dependents
Employee assistance program (EAP)

Additional Compensation Details

$112,600- $163,300K/ annually
Yearly review with possibility of increase based on performance and tenure

Job Description

The Enterprise Transformation Project Manager leads cross-functional initiatives that advance the organization’s strategic priorities, improve business performance, and strengthen the customer and employee experience. This role translates strategy into executable plans, aligns stakeholders around shared outcomes, and guides initiatives from discovery and business-case development through implementation, adoption, and benefits realization.

This highly visible role operates across business and technology functions, processes, people, data, and enabling capabilities. The position partners with executive sponsors, operational leaders, subject-matter experts, change champions, and external partners to simplify work, build organizational readiness, and deliver sustainable, measurable value. Technology may support some initiatives, but the role’s primary focus is business transformation and successful adoption.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (
any combination of the following job duties)
:

Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise transformation initiatives spanning operating models, business processes, organizational capabilities, customer experience, and enabling solutions.
Partner with executive sponsors and business leaders to define the case for change, desired outcomes, scope, success measures, and governance.
Maintain a tight working relationship across the business and technology leaders to drive forward strategic projects whether they are business-driven, technology-driven, or a combination of both.
Translate strategic priorities into transformation roadmaps, integrated work plans, milestones, resource requirements, and accountable ownership.
Facilitate current-state assessments, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process mapping to identify root causes, opportunities, and dependencies.
Design and coordinate future-state processes, roles, decision rights, controls, and performance measures with cross-functional teams.
Build alignment across departments, resolve competing priorities, and support timely decisions through clear options, recommendations, and escalation paths.
Lead change-impact assessments and organizational readiness activities; partner with leaders on communications, training, engagement, and reinforcement plans.
Establish practical governance and facilitate kickoff meetings, working sessions, status reviews, steering committee updates, and post-implementation reviews.
Manage initiative scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and changes while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes.
Define baselines, key performance indicators, and benefit measures; track adoption, operational results, and value realization after implementation.
Coordinate internal teams, external partners, and vendors, ensuring deliverables meet business requirements and support the intended transformation.
Provide concise, decision-oriented reporting on progress, financials, risks, outcomes, and actions to sponsors and stakeholders.
Embed continuous-improvement practices, capture lessons learned, and help business teams sustain new ways of working.
Coach employees and project participants in transformation, project management, problem-solving, and change leadership practices.
Ensure company policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and internal controls are followed.
Travel occasionally to branches, operating locations, and conferences as needed.
All employees are responsible for food safety and are expected to notify the appropriate manager, supervisor, or key personnel if they witness any compromise to food safety or food quality.

Transformation Governance And Documentation

Own and maintain the transformation charter, business case, roadmap, governance materials, integrated plan, and close-out records.
Develop and own company standards for project management and other tools as needed.
Document current-state findings, future-state designs, business requirements, process changes, stakeholder impacts, and accountable owners.
Maintain risk, issue, dependency, change, assumption, and decision records with clear ownership, approvals, and traceability.
Ensure readiness, communications, training, testing, transition, and partner deliverables are reviewed and approved by appropriate business owners.

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

What We Are Looking For

At Aurora, our next generation hardware/software platform will enable scaling to tens of thousands of driverless trucks. We’re searching for a Senior Staff Technical Program Manager to join Aurora’s Software Product & Program Management team focusing on hardware/software integration and new vehicle bring-up programs. This role will partner closely with our software and embedded firmware organizations to bring together the on-board software required to bring our new hardware programs to life. This role will also partner deeply with teams outside of Software including various parts of our Hardware Engineering and Operations teams.

In this role, you will

Partner tightly with software and firmware engineering leaders to drive successful planning and delivery of software for hardware/software integration programs.
Serve as a go-to resource for information and up-to-date status for relevant programs including facilitating regular executive program reviews.
Develop detailed credible engineering plans for bringing up software to enable new hardware platforms, from conception to on-road.
Partner with other TPMs and Product Managers (across hardware and software) to understand the company product roadmap and upcoming hardware programs requiring software support.
Partner closely with Hardware Product and Engineering teams to inform future hardware architecture from the lens of software requirements and feasibility.
Engage Vehicle Operations teams across all sites to help facilitate initial bring-up, testing, and eventually deployment of new hardware platforms.
Be a conduit for feedback from first-line operations and reliability engineers to improve product capabilities and development processes.
Help evolve and streamline approaches and processes for bringing up new hardware platforms in conjunction with the hardware, software, and operations teams.
Proactively identify and remove obstacles to unblock team execution and balance competing priorities, escalating when necessary to maintain momentum and clear roadblocks.
Work deeply with our industry hardware partners to plan, develop, and deliver critical components of our Aurora Driver Kit.

Required Qualifications

This role requires up to 25% travel in the US and to Europe as needed to collaborate with our hardware partners and other cross-functional teams.
Minimum of 7 years experience as a Technical Program Manager, Product Manager, or Engineering Manager, in an autonomous systems, robotics, embedded systems, or software development environment. A familiarity with automotive platforms, autonomous vehicles, or safety critical software development is beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Information Systems or a related area, or the equivalent in experience with evidence of exceptional ability preferred.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to adjust communication based on audience.
Solid technical aptitude and an ability to understand technical designs, software development lifecycle, challenges and risks; ability to work closely with engineers.
Strong experience in project management; practical familiarity with both Agile and Waterfall methodologies and ability to apply them where best suited.
Ability to work in one of our offices at least 3 days per week.

We believe in-person work increases collaboration, empathy and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, we operate in a hybrid work environment where Aurorans are in office at least 3 days per week.

Plan A Technologies is looking for an experienced Casino Systems Project Manager.
In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of a product or service project for a client, from inception to installation. you must have at least 5+ years of dedicated project management experience leading information technology (IT) projects to be considered for this role.

End-to-End Project Execution: Drive the delivery of new and enhanced gaming system solutions focused on boosting customer satisfaction and operational performance through technology.
Schedule & Budget Oversight: Own project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation to ensure key milestones and deliverable goals are met on time and within scope.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Facilitate alignment and extensive interaction across multidisciplinary teams—including Sales, Systems Engineering, Services Consultants, and Product Development.
Technical & Stakeholder Management: Apply project management methodologies to balance competing technical interests, navigate project risks, and run high-level internal stakeholder meetings.
Business Process Mapping: Collaborate with business partners to analyze current ("as-is") operational workflows and design optimized future-state ("to-be") business processes.
Technical & System Documentation: Coordinate comprehensive documentation requirements for system conversions, software upgrades, third-party interfaces, business logic, reporting, and workflow forms.
Client Enablement: Assist with configuring proprietary software platforms and conducting hands-on training sessions for client operational teams as needed.
Flexible Work & Travel Model: Work effectively in a hybrid setup (remote and on-site at client locations), maintaining availability for mandatory project travel.

Experience

Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience.
5+ years project management experience managing information technology (IT) based projects.
Demonstrated experience managing and delivering multiple, highly technical projects—often concurrently—across cross-functional business and engineering teams.
Proven track record in gathering, documenting, assimilating, estimating, and prioritizing technical requirements based on business input.
Practical familiarity with established project management frameworks (e.g., PMI methodologies or SAP) and proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including MS Project.
Working knowledge of networked systems, IT inventory management, and technical platform deployments.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven expertise in group meeting facilitation and stakeholder presentations.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
Initiative and drive to do great things.

PMP desired but not essential
Gaming operations experience preferred

Operational knowledge of standalone networked and wireless gaming devices.

About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

As a Staff Technical Program Manager for Vehicle Systems Architecture, you will serve as the primary execution partner to the Vehicle Systems Architecture lead. You will be responsible for translating the holistic technical vision for the vehicle architecture into a single, integrated program plan and driving its execution across all engineering functions. This role is the critical link between high-level strategy and tactical delivery, requiring a deep technical foundation, mastery of complex program management, and the ability to orchestrate a wide array of cross-functional teams to deliver a cohesive and world-class product.

Responsibilities

Serve as the right hand to the Vehicle Systems Architecture lead, translating the high-level technical vision and architectural strategy into a detailed, cross-functional, and actionable program plan.
Drive the definition, prioritization, and maintenance of the overall vehicle technical roadmap in close collaboration with all cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring alignment with top-level product goals.
Create and manage the integrated master plan for all key vehicle system deliverables, working with engineering partners to break down complex initiatives into clear execution plans with well-defined milestones and dependencies.
Act as a key technical liaison and accountability partner with key RV Tech stakeholders, including: Rivian, Volkswagen Group, industry partners, to align roadmaps and architecture deliverables.
Establish and refine processes and communication channels to boost execution efficiency, foster seamless cross-functional collaboration, and provide a single source of truth for program status.
Be the primary owner for identifying and managing vehicle-level technical risks, cross-functional dependencies and program trade-offs. You will proactively surface issues, drive mitigation plans, and provide clear escalations to leadership.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
6+ years of progressive Technical Program Management experience, with a proven track record of shipping complex products that integrate hardware, software, and mechanical systems.
Proven experience in leading real-time, safety critical embedded systems from concept through production.
Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to effectively lead and influence cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated experience bridging Agile and Waterfall development methodologies, with advanced proficiency in Jira, Confluence, and other program management tools.

Experience with complex system architectures (automotive, autonomous driving, new space, robotics, etc).
Previous experience as a software or hardware product development engineer.
Deep understanding of embedded software architectures for real-time operating systems (RTOS) and other resource-constrained embedded systems.
Familiarity with safety-critical development processes and standards (e.g., ISO 26262).

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs
.

Meet the Team

Cisco Cloud Security Group is a leading provider of Cloud Security and DNS services, enabling the world to connect to the Internet with confidence on any device, anywhere, anytime.

Our approach is twofold; first Umbrella, our cloud-delivered security service, blocks advanced attacks including malware, botnets, and phishing threats, while our predictive intelligence engine uses machine learning to automate protection against newly-discovered threats before they can reach our customers. Today, we handle more than 80 billion daily Internet requests from 65 million+ users around the world. Our global network has proven reliability and adds no latency. We protect each and every one of our customers' devices globally without any hardware to install or software to maintain.

Working at Cisco Cloud Security group means being surrounded by passionate and creative people who are determined to disrupt the Internet security industry with innovative ideas, world-class research and unrivaled products and services. It's a place where the best ideas are quickly transformed into products, features, campaigns and company-wide practices, with nearly 100% year-over-year usage growth.

Your Impact

As Engineering Program Manager within Cisco Cloud Security organization, you will be working very closely with the Software Engineering team, supporting cloud products and deliverables. You bring an AI-first Technical Program Management lens to everything you do, embedding artificial intelligence, machine learning, and intelligent automation into how programs are planned, executed, and delivered.

Besides solid program delivery and technical skills, you have proven experience in problem solving, managing multiple projects simultaneously, a deep understanding of cloud product development, strong background in CI/CD development model, and delivery of complex large-scale software projects.

You thrive in a fast-paced and demanding environment. You have the ability to think creatively and critically, lead through intellect, and are willing to roll-up your sleeves when needed. In addition, you are able to partner across a wide variety of functions. You have strong internal drive, a tenacious spirit, good communication skills and a collaborative method of working

Key Responsibilities

Bring strong Technical Program Management expertise with an AI-first vision, pioneering the adoption of AI-driven tools, automation, and data-informed decision-making to accelerate program delivery and drive innovation across teams
Support, track and manage complex program execution, cross-functional coordination, and inter/intra team communications to deliver outstanding, high quality program outcomes
Track and maintain cross-functional dependencies/deliverables, work with other cross-functional groups within Cisco Security to manage dependencies and deliverables
Provide timely issue resolution and critical path management; and facilitate good communication.
Drive day-to day program activities to meet overall program objective
Be self-directed with the ability to review changes and weigh tradeoffs between engineering resources and operational improvements
Provide weekly updates and offer multiple levels of status across a wide spectrum of individual contributors to executive management
Drive an AI-first approach to program management, identifying and deploying AI/ML tools and intelligent automation to streamline planning, reporting, risk detection, and decision-making
Partner with engineering teams to plan and deliver AI/ML-powered features, demonstrating data-driven insights and predictive analytics to improve program velocity, quality, and outcomes

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's + 8 years, a Master’s degree + 6 years, or PhD + 3 years of complex program management (preferred in software cloud environments), using both agile and waterfall. Degree should be in Engineering, Computer Science or related technical field.
3+ years of experience applying AI/ML tools, GenAI assistants, and intelligent automation to program management.
3+ years of experience coordinating cross-functional projects, facilitating team meetings, and collaborating with geographically distributed teams.
Prior experience in Lean Enterprise / Agile / Kanban practices and supporting tools.
Experience with defect tracking applications like JIRA and business applications such as Word, Excel and Project.

Preferred Qualifications

Able to communicate well with cross-functional team members, be able to efficiently collaborate with and influence team members to achieve project goals, and contribute positively to the engineering community environment.
Ability to understand, discuss / communicate technical concepts, with both technical and non-technical individuals.
Ability to find opportunities to embed AI across the software delivery lifecycle.
Working knowledge of cloud and network security concepts and technologies such as SASE, Security Service Edge (SSE), Zero Trust, DNS-layer security, secure web gateway (SWG), and firewall/cloud-delivered security.
Familiarity with security compliance and certification frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR) and experience supporting audit- or compliance-driven programs.
Experience delivering programs in a DevSecOps environment, integrating security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines and the software development lifecycle
Awareness of AI/ML security and responsible-AI considerations, including model risk, data privacy, secure handling of sensitive data, and threat modeling for AI-enabled products.
Understanding of vulnerability management, incident response, and secure SDLC practices; ability to coordinate cross-functional security remediation efforts.
Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA Security+, or CISM are a plus.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager, Devices
jobs.description:
About Atomic Machines:

Atomic Machines is ushering in a new era of micromanufacturing with its Matter Compiler™ technology platform. This platform enables new classes of micromachines to be designed and built by providing manufacturing processes and a materials library that are inaccessible to semiconductor manufacturing methods. It unlocks MEMS manufacturing not only for device classes that could never be produced by semiconductor methods, but also for entirely new categories. Furthermore, this digital platform is fully programmable in the way 3D printing is digital, but whereas 3D printing produces parts of a single material using a single process, the Matter Compiler™ technology platform is a multi-process, multi-material system: bits and raw materials go in, and complete, functional micromachines come out. The Atomic Machines team has also created an exciting first device, made possible only through the Matter Compiler™ technology platform, addressing a critical need in the rapidly evolving AI data center world, and we are commercializing it now.

Our offices are in Emeryville and Santa Clara, California.

About The Role:

We are seeking a highly technical Engineering Program Manager to own the program for that first device's successor, end to end: from requirements still maturing with lead customers, through qualification, certification, and manufacturing scale-up on the Matter Compiler, to commercial launch. That successor is a new class of micromachine, made possible only by the Matter Compiler, and you will be the leader that delivers it.

At Atomic Machines, Program Management is a leverage function, and its core skill is clarity. The Device program's technical leadership is already in place: device design, process, test, and reliability are each led by deep domain owners who move fast and expect the same. You lead that team as one program, and you drive the outcome, integrated plan, customer commitments, tradeoffs, operating cadence, and decisions that keep every discipline moving as one. Technical direction belongs to the domain owners; turning their work into the outcomes of certified, scaling, revenue-generating products belongs to you. This role is for someone who was an individual contributor in complex technical domains and moved into program leadership on purpose: to influence product direction, align engineering and manufacturing, and own outcomes end to end.

What You'll Do:

Develop and drive the program roadmap end to end: set goals, define milestones and evidence gates, and build the accountability structure that connects daily engineering work to business outcomes and customer commitments.
Direct cross-functional execution across device physics, fabrication processes, automation, and system integration: set the deliverables, sequencing, and resource calls for engineering, operations, and leadership.
Build and run the integrated plan connecting customer commitments, design maturity, process capability, and manufacturing readiness. Run the operating cadence that keeps it honest.
Turn maturing customer requirements into committed, testable targets, and hold the program to them.
Build the program structures that keep device and process development in lockstep with the Matter Compiler platform. Move development from R&D into production and define what each handoff must prove.
Structure the program around evidence and short learning loops: design the build-test-learn iteration cycles, give every open unknown an experiment with a pass/fail criterion, and let the schedule follow from results.
Own the qualification and certification path (e.g., UL/IEC) as a program commitment shaped into the design from day one.
Deliver the outcome: the device demonstrated, evaluated by lead customers, and qualified through production ramp.
Institutionalize what you learn: build the systems, rhythms, and decision structures the whole organization runs on, so the next program moves faster than this one.

What You'll Need:

8+ years spanning hands-on engineering and technical program leadership on complex multidisciplinary hardware: you have personally taken things from thought to build and owned programs that others depended on.
A track record of taking integrated hardware systems from concept through manufacturing release and commercial delivery, with the judgment to know when a decision needs more rigor and when to move fast.
Deep technical fluency in at least one core engineering domain and productive command across the rest: you hold your own with engineers designing in coupled physical domains — electromagnetics, structural mechanics, thermal behavior, fluidics, and materials.
You drive senior technical leads to deliver at a high level: clarity, structure, and pace, while technical direction stays with the domain owner.
Relentlessness in driving through ambiguity: turning unresolved requirements into scope, evidence gates, and a plan the team runs.
Conviction in iterative hardware development and short learning loops — build early, test early, learn fast, continually finding the shortest learning loop.
True Ownership of your program and domain, with bottom-line-up-front communication, trusted by engineers and leadership alike. The strongest people you've worked with would choose to work with you again.
BS or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Materials Science.

Nice to Have:

Reliability engineering for microscale or precision devices: accelerated life testing, environmental stress testing, and long-term performance characterization.
Experience driving a product through UL, IEC, or equivalent certification.
Experience standing up programs from ground zero, then driving reliability growth to manufacturing scale.

Company Description

Every minute of every day, Smiths Detection’s threat detection and security screening technology helps to protect people and infrastructure, making the world a safer place.

Smiths Detection is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security.

Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R&D centres, with a global network of 3,000 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security.

This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state-of-the-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day.

Job Description

Engage appropriate stakeholders and program managers to ensure collaboration in development and full implementation of HSE policies and procedures to ensure regulatory and company-wide policy compliance.
Lead and embed a high performing HSE culture across our UK and Ireland operations.
Develop training and audit/inspection tools to support robust site HSE program. Support regional specific HSE processes and procedures in support of company-wide initiatives and direction.
Develop and implement plans, processes and procedures to ensure conformance with regulatory OSHA, ISO 14001 & OHSAS 45001 certifications and company requirements and initiatives at all UK and Europe sites
Support the UK HQ with ensuring it meets its EHS legislative requirements.
Perform the site security controller duties. Must have Security Clearance or the ability to obtain this.
Drive continuous improvement in HSE performance for the UK and Ireland operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Advise site management team on HSE compliance requirements for our manufacturing site and service repair shop. Provide leadership and subject matter expertise that ensures appropriate HSE systems are in place. Coach site teams to improve HSE performance and engagement.
Manage and track site HSE Key Performance Indicators and drive site continuous improvement toward goals. Support problem resolution and provide leadership and guidance for the Site.
Ensure the timely & accurate reporting and investigation of HSE performance data and incidents.
Drive proactive safety culture across the UK.
Instigate and review vetting submissions and associated documentation and advise on overseas travel requests.
Chair Key Security meeting on site.

Support site execution of tactical initiatives in order to eliminate hazards and risks. Drive continuous HSE performance improvement.
Continuously assess HSE hazards and risks and assist where specific technical expertise is required to meet local regulations or company policies, procedures and programs.
Plan and direct HSE activities and programs; establish priority for project execution based upon site resources and cost of implementation.

Lead external registration and surveillance audit schedules for ISO 14001 & OHSAS 18001 (45001) with selected certifying body or registrar.

Support emergency preparedness and response planning

Competencies and Abilities:

Results driven

Prioritize HSE initiatives based on risk, cost, and operational impact.

Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 systems. Awareness of ISO 27001 and its application.

Ability to delegate and manage multiple responsibilities effectively

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. jobs.title: Security Analyst
jobs.description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

Benevity is looking for a Security Analyst to join our Information Security team in a generalist role spanning security operations, application security, and security enablement. In this position, you will own the triage and investigation of security alerts, partner with engineering teams to fix vulnerabilities, and help build resources that strengthen our overall defense. Working independently on day-to-day operations while collaborating with senior analysts, you will leverage AI tools to accelerate workflows while exploring AI-related product risks. We are seeking a curious, analytical, and continuous learner who thrives on solving puzzles and empowering others to build a safer digital world.

What You’ll Do

Triage, validate, and investigate alerts across core security tooling (EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, CSPM, MDR) to establish scope and determine escalation
Maintain clear documentation, write incident response playbooks, and participate in an on-call rotation
Conduct threat intelligence research and contribute to post-incident reviews to drive preventive control improvements
Analyze SAST, SCA, and DAST findings, providing engineering teams with actionable exploitation context for remediation
Assist with threat modeling and architectural reviews to catch security risks early in product design
Leverage AI tools for faster triage and investigation while practicing safe data handling and validating outputs
Identify AI-specific product risks, including prompt injection, insecure tool use, and third-party model exposure
Track vulnerability remediation lifecycles, monitor SLA compliance, and report on recurring security patterns
Partner with engineering and fraud teams on joint investigations, security enablement content, and self-serve resources
Track and report on key security metrics, trends, and process developments

What You’ll Bring

3+ years of experience in security operations, information security, or a closely related technical role
Hands-on experience with security tooling across categories such as EDR, SIEM, CSPM, WAF, cloud-native logging, and SAST or SCA
Solid working knowledge of networking, operating systems, and cloud fundamentals
Practical experience using AI tooling in a technical context with a thoughtful view on its strengths and limitations
Scripting proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash, paired with an interest in automating repetitive tasks
Familiarity with security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a puzzle-solving mindset and a drive for verifiable answers
Clear, inclusive written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating technical concepts for non-specialists
A curious, continuous-learning approach and a collaborative desire to support teammates
Experience in SaaS, cloud-native, containerized, or API-driven environments, or relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CySA+, GCIH)

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a Company Where DEIB Isn’t a Buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

The Defense Systems CIDO PMO is seeking a Senior Chief Information and Data Office (CIDO) Program Manager (CIDO PM)
in support of Strategic Deterrent Systems Division (SDS Div) Functions in the Northern Utah area. Specifically, the ESPM will support Sentinel Program
. In supporting Sentinel the successful candidate will have responsibility to support all CIDO services to the program to include coordination of operations and maintenance contribution to the existing Digital EcoSystem and well as executing new projects to stand up capabilities on the Digital EcoSystem Roadmap. The CIDO PM will be the primary interface between the Sentinel Program Leadership and enterprise groups within CIDO Support team.

The CIDO leads all aspects of implementing innovative information technology (IT) solutions that deliver value and enable SDS Div/Sentinel Program strategic business initiatives. This includes leading all IT strategic planning and implementations, as well as day-to-day IT activity across the Sentinel program. In addition, the CIDO PM, in coordination with CIDO and Global Operations service lines is accountable for the delivery of all services that the CIDO provides, including Service Center Operations, Cyber Security, and Security.

Responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:

Execute Chief Information and Data Office strategy and operational activities including service delivery, technical requirements gathering, build versus buy analysis, infrastructure solutions and project execution
Act as the CIDO ambassador to program leadership, functional organizations, and site employees and advocate to represent program requirements and concerns to the Defense Systems CIDO PMO management
Effectively interact with members of the CIDO, classified IT, and business leadership teams to optimize strategies to support goals and objectives, including managing budget and costs
Oversee proposal development, staffing plan development, product and service acquisition and delivery, teaming relationships and communication activities, thereby ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery and customer satisfaction
Coordinate testing and acceptance of CIDO initiatives, pre-production and support user training, and on-going feedback
Monitor customer satisfaction with service delivery and engage CIDO and Global Operations resources to assist as required to meet and exceed CIDO and Global Operations service level objectives
Develop strong/empowered relationships with cross functional sector groups. Drive and influence simplification improvements while understanding business partner/program business objectives and needs.
Escalate service actions and associated delivery priorities as required.
Identify systemic technical and service delivery challenges and then coordinate solutions with CIDO and Global Operations functional representatives; engage constructively to identify solutions
Develop, present, and obtain approvals for CIDO budgets, project plans, and functional/business unit initiatives
Deliver leadership, peer engagement, and highly effective collaboration across the Defense Systems CIDO PMO supporting Defense Systems sector, SDS Div and CIDO enterprise initiatives and project.   

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of related experience or Master’s degree and 6 years of related experience
3 years of management experience/ program management experience
US Citizenship with Active U.S. Government Secret clearance with a reinvestigation date occurring in the last 6 years with the ability to obtain and maintain Top Secret clearance and SAP Access.
Must have experience in either project management, cost, budgets, or scheduling.
Must have familiarity with technical solutions, infrastructure implementations, process/project documentation, and/or liaison interfacing for large enterprise organizations.
Demonstrated ability to pro-actively identify issues and solutions to those issues, and drives issues rapidly to closure.
Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communications skills.
Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior Northrop Grumman Defense Sector SDS Div or Sentinel Program Specific experience.
Broad background in IT Infrastructure, business applications, and operations.
Ability to perform risk & opportunity analysis and prepare detail cost and technical proposals.
Active Top Secret security clearance with an adjudication or reinvestigation date within the past 5 years, and the ability to maintain the required clearance; additionally, the selected candidate will be required to obtain SAP access

CIDO

Primary Level Salary Range: $151,500.00 - $227,300.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

Experience with DISS, SIMS, Lenel, or similar databases

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

People Management & Team Development

Directly manage a team of Network Implementation Engineers across project delivery lifecycle; set clear performance expectations, conduct structured 1:1s, and own individual development plans.
Build a culture of execution discipline — ticket hygiene, change management compliance, documentation quality, and rigorous project close-out.
Identify skill gaps and build structured training and certification pathways aligned to ECI’s service portfolio.
Manage performance formally and informally; address issues directly, constructively, and on record when required.
Participate in hiring decisions for the implementation function, including technical assessments and structured panel interviews.

Project Delivery & Program Management

Own end-to-end delivery of network implementation projects spanning new client onboarding, infrastructure refreshes, office builds, and technology migrations.
Define and enforce project intake, scoping, scheduling, and resource allocation standards across the team.
Maintain active visibility across all open workstreams; surface and resolve blockers before they become client escalations.
Drive post-implementation reviews and root cause analysis; translate findings into repeatable process improvements for the team.
Coordinate with Client Services, Solutions Architecture, and pre-sales to align implementation timelines with client commitments and ECI delivery standards.

Technical Standards & Oversight

Serve as the technical authority for ECI’s implementation standards covering Cisco (Catalyst, Nexus, IOS-XE/XR), Palo Alto firewalls, Meraki, and SD-WAN platforms.
Review and approve low-level designs (LLDs) and implementation runbooks before execution.
Establish and enforce configuration standards that ensure consistency, repeatability, and alignment with client security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, NIST, HIPAA).
Serve as escalation point for complex in-flight technical issues; engage hands-on when warranted while ensuring the team learns from every resolution.
Champion Zero Trust and SASE architecture principles within ECI’s implementation workflows.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

Own implementation status communication to client stakeholders; translate technical risk into clear business impact language.
Represent the implementation team in internal delivery reviews, capacity planning, and service improvement forums.
Maintain ECI’s documentation standard across implementation plans, network diagrams, as-built records, and configuration baselines — ensuring clean handoffs to managed services teams.

Qualifications

Required

10+ years of progressive network engineering experience with a demonstrable track record in enterprise implementation, ideally within an MSP or multi-client environment.
3+ years of direct people management — you have hired engineers, set goals, handled performance, and actively developed talent.
Deep technical proficiency in Cisco networking (Catalyst, Nexus, IOS-XE/XR), Palo Alto firewalls (App-ID, Threat Prevention, VPN, Panorama), and wireless (WLC, Meraki MR/MS/MX).
Strong working knowledge of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP), VLANs, QoS, and IPv4/IPv6 fundamentals.
Proven ability to run multiple concurrent implementation projects with accountability for schedules, resources, and stakeholder communication.
Solid understanding of security frameworks, compliance standards, and change management governance in regulated client environments.

Preferred

Active CCNP, CCIE, or PCNSE certification; equivalent demonstrated expertise considered.
Experience with SD-WAN (Cisco Viptela, VeloCloud) and SASE / Zero Trust architecture in client deployments.
Familiarity with automation tooling (Python, Ansible) to drive repeatability and reduce manual effort across the team.
Experience with network monitoring platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, Meraki Insights) and using telemetry data to drive delivery quality.
Hedge fund, financial services, or similarly regulated client-facing environment experience is a strong plus.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.

Who We Are Looking For

Beyond credentials, we are hiring for a specific leadership profile. The right candidate:

Communicates expectations without ambiguity and follows through consistently. Leads with clarity.
Engineers respect them because they know the stack — not just the title. Commands technical credibility.
Holds the team and themselves to high execution standards without micromanaging. Drives accountability.
Focused on delivery quality and reliability, not just activity volume. Solves for client outcomes.
Understands the job is to build the best team — not to be the best individual engineer on it. Scales through people.

ECI’s culture is all about connection -
connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and the range for this role is a maximum of $142,000 annually with flexible PTO, health benefit eligibility the first of the month, life insurance, pet insurance, 401K and so much more! If you believe you’d be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever, we’d like to hear from you!!

The Site Project Manager is responsible for site-specific Post Go-Live Transition Readiness project plan management; completing deliverable status reports to the client and internal teams; coordinating activities and ownership with client counterparts; executing Transition Readiness Methodology to ensure local informatics readiness to assume ownership of EHR support; advising the client on expectations in a consultative role; and managing client communication.

Manage the site-specific project plan and timeline and drive local site Informatics to success in preparing them for their roles Post Go-Live

Project Management & Execution

Professional presence with the ability to foster a culture of change and adaptability

Comfortable managing ambiguity and navigating complex challenges with a solution-oriented mindset
Positive attitude and commitment to fostering collaboration and continuous improvement

jobs.description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

Benevity is looking for a Security Analyst to join our Information Security team in a generalist role spanning security operations, application security, and security enablement. In this position, you will own the triage and investigation of security alerts, partner with engineering teams to fix vulnerabilities, and help build resources that strengthen our overall defense. Working independently on day-to-day operations while collaborating with senior analysts, you will leverage AI tools to accelerate workflows while exploring AI-related product risks. We are seeking a curious, analytical, and continuous learner who thrives on solving puzzles and empowering others to build a safer digital world.

What You’ll Do

Triage, validate, and investigate alerts across core security tooling (EDR, SIEM, IDS/IPS, CSPM, MDR) to establish scope and determine escalation
Maintain clear documentation, write incident response playbooks, and participate in an on-call rotation
Conduct threat intelligence research and contribute to post-incident reviews to drive preventive control improvements
Analyze SAST, SCA, and DAST findings, providing engineering teams with actionable exploitation context for remediation
Assist with threat modeling and architectural reviews to catch security risks early in product design
Leverage AI tools for faster triage and investigation while practicing safe data handling and validating outputs
Identify AI-specific product risks, including prompt injection, insecure tool use, and third-party model exposure
Track vulnerability remediation lifecycles, monitor SLA compliance, and report on recurring security patterns
Partner with engineering and fraud teams on joint investigations, security enablement content, and self-serve resources
Track and report on key security metrics, trends, and process developments

What You’ll Bring

3+ years of experience in security operations, information security, or a closely related technical role
Hands-on experience with security tooling across categories such as EDR, SIEM, CSPM, WAF, cloud-native logging, and SAST or SCA
Solid working knowledge of networking, operating systems, and cloud fundamentals
Practical experience using AI tooling in a technical context with a thoughtful view on its strengths and limitations
Scripting proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or Bash, paired with an interest in automating repetitive tasks
Familiarity with security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a puzzle-solving mindset and a drive for verifiable answers
Clear, inclusive written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating technical concepts for non-specialists
A curious, continuous-learning approach and a collaborative desire to support teammates
Experience in SaaS, cloud-native, containerized, or API-driven environments, or relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CySA+, GCIH)

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a Company Where DEIB Isn’t a Buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.
